partners.mechanism_chain: IL2RA (HGNC:6027) —DISRUPTS→ IL-2 receptor alpha chain (CD25) (GO:0005894); IL-2 receptor alpha chain (CD25) (GO:0005894) —DISRUPTS→ IL-2 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280101); IL2RG (HGNC:6025) —DISRUPTS→ Common gamma chain (GO:0031353); Common gamma chain (GO:0031353) —DISRUPTS→ IL-2 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280101); IL-2 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280101) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency (HP:0001861); IL-2 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280101) —LEADS_TO→ T-cell lymphopenia (HP:0001880); IL-2 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280101) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired T-cell proliferation (HP:0030142). Loss-of-function mutations in IL2RA (encoding CD25) impair the high-affinity IL-2 receptor, while mutations in IL2RG (encoding the common gamma chain, shared by IL-2R) also disrupt IL-2 signaling. Both deficiencies lead to a critical failure in T-cell development and function, resulting in severe combined immunodeficiency. The convergence is on the IL-2 signaling pathway, where defects in either the alpha subunit or the shared gamma chain lead to a common downstream effect of immune deficiency.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that there is no detectable overlap in the molecular pathways regulating T-cell activation and immune responses between the mechanisms driving CD25 deficiency and gastric cancer, or that mutations in IL2RA do not have any discernible downstream effects on pathways implicated in gastric carcinogenesis. _(variant: Exome or genome sequencing data showing that pathogenic variants in IL2RA are absent or extremely rare in individuals with gastric cancer, and conversely, common variants associated with gastric cancer are not found to impact IL2RA function.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the link between immune dysregulation in CD25 deficiency and gastric cancer could inform novel therapeutic strategies, such as immunotherapies or immune-modulating drugs, for gastric cancer patients, especially those with underlying immune deficiencies or chronic inflammatory conditions.
